items.title: Sonny Henry Interview, 1959-10-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I think he lives near a lemon. I'll get lemon to get him in contact with me... Lemon doesn't have a telephone either.

ctx.x: He lived up there somewhere. I don't know why he lived there. I'm going to tell the truth.

Well, we'll find him. I think he lives near a lemon. I'll get lemon to get him in contact with me. Yeah, he's going to throw that. If I can find lemon. That's another problem. Lemon doesn't have a telephone either.
